title: ui_send is an app-wide slot not keyed to the command or account that produced it
trigger: A composer send under the driver whose agent_route_send runs in a deferred effect after the step's take (a with_injecting deferred half), then an account switch or another command.
effect: AgentBridge::ui_send is a QuillApp (app-wide) Option taken after each step by whichever command runs next; it carries chat_id but no account or command id, so a late send would be delivered with another command's reply, possibly after a switch to another account.
fix: Carry the request id (and screen epoch) in UiSend and only take a send whose id matches the running command; drop it on screen change.

title: The agent tree is the last drawn frame's, but it is checked against the surface of the state now
trigger: With chat G granted and chat X not: while an agent's read_ui_tree waits for a frame, the user opens X and then G again within one 16 ms poll, before the frame for G is drawn.
effect: agent_tree computes driver_surface from current state (granted chat G) but reads window.a11y_tree_snapshot() of the last frame, which shows X. The conversation slot is tagged REGION_CHAT only (no chat=<id> tag), so redact allows its content and X's messages reach the agent.
fix: Tag the conversation region with chat_tag(open chat) so redaction follows the frame's own chat, or record the surface each frame is drawn for and compare it with the frame read.

title: Takeover pill bounds are the main window's but are compared with the pointer of whichever window's input probe fired
trigger: While an agent drives, click near the top centre of a chat window (where the main window's pill sits in main-window coordinates).
effect: The click counts as on the pill, so it does not pause the agent; the user's input in that chat window is ignored by the takeover.
fix: Record the pill's window id with its bounds (or keep it per window) and treat input as on_controls only when the event's window is the one that painted the pill.

title: activate reads the composer of a slot that is swapped in
trigger: In chat window X choose Open in new window for X's own chat (or a notification click routed while X is in place).
effect: slot.composer is the main window's composer while X's scope is in place (swap_slot), so focus goes to the wrong entity and X's compose field does not take the keyboard.
fix: Look the composer up through the in-place state when the slot's scope is in place, or focus via the window's own view.

title: Failed chat window open leaves the chat open nowhere
trigger: Open in new window for the chat active in the main window when creating the OS window fails.
effect: The main window already left the chat (leave_open_chat, draft moved) and the Err arm closes the window chat, so the chat shows in no window; only an error note appears.
fix: On Err re-select the chat in the main window, or leave the main window only after the window opened.

title: Reopen closed window loses the entry when the reopen is refused
trigger: Close a chat window, lock Quill or let the chat vanish/driver open_chat_window fail, then Reopen closed window.
effect: closed.pop() runs before open_chat_window_at, which returns early (chat unknown, locked, driver error) without putting the entry back; the window can no longer be reopened.
fix: Peek the last entry and pop it only when the window opened (or push back on the early returns).

title: route_chat_open drops the ChatOpen (forward draft, dropped files, compose text, inline return) silently on three paths
trigger: Drag selected messages or files onto a chat row (or Forward 'continue in chat') while (a) the target chat window's session view is gone (in_window_scope returns None), (b) main_window.handle is None (`let main = self.main_window.handle?`), or (c) the account switches before the deferred select_chat_request runs (in_screen_scope returns None / main.update fails).
effect: The carried forward draft/files/text vanish with no note and no chat opens; the source selection was already consumed so the user's picked messages are lost.
fix: Return a Result/enum from route_chat_open (`Routed::{Landed, Here(open), Dropped}`), and on Dropped restore the carry to its source (ForwardStage::Selecting) or post a note.

title: Account switch started from inside a chat window's update neither saves nor removes that window
trigger: Active window is a chat window; switch account from the OS menu/Dock/secret-code path (os_menus/mod.rs:192, secret_codes_ui.rs:147), so close_chat_windows_for_switch runs inside that window's update.
effect: save_chat_windows_now uses handle.update(...).ok()? so the leased window is skipped and its place is not saved under the outgoing account (not restored on switching back); handle.update(remove_window) also fails for it, so the OS window lingers until its next render notices window_chats lost it and removes it (mark_closed already set, deferred remove).
fix: Read each window's bounds from the data ChatWindows already keeps (WindowPlace in open.slot/note_place) instead of handle.update, and remove windows through cx.defer.

title: ChatWindows::save_pending is a bool armed before a screen-scoped timer and cleared only inside the timer's update
trigger: Move or close a chat window (arms save_pending and the 600 ms spawn_screen timer), then let the screen epoch move before the timer fires without the screen being replaced (screen_leaves_later with no main window: 'the old UI stays under the new epoch').
effect: The timer's update returns Gone, save_pending is never cleared, schedule_chat_windows_save returns early forever and window places are no longer saved; close_chat_windows_for_switch also treats it as 'a save is due'. Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt.
fix: Replace the bool with `save: SaveTimer { Idle, Due(Task<()>) }` stored in ChatWindows so dropping the owner drops the timer and the stage is the task itself; clear it when the task is cancelled.

title: Restore::Offered has no exit if the offer box goes away without calling on_ok/on_cancel
trigger: The 'Restore chat windows?' alert (open_alert_dialog, not a registered DialogSpec) is replaced or closed by something that runs no callback (kit close_all_dialogs runs no on_close, another kit dialog opening over the single modal slot, close_kit_dialog_if_done closing the top box).
effect: restore stays Offered for the session: the question is never asked again, the windows are never restored, and nothing re-opens the box until restart. Only the account switch (which replaces ChatWindows) leaves this stage.
fix: Register the offer as a DialogSpec whose flag is Restore::Offered, so the shell syncs the box from the stage and a lost box re-opens or falls to Done; or tie Offered to the alert's close.

title: Demo apply_demo_sticker/gif/edit/delete/pin_toggle/forward/archive/pin/marked_as_unread/notification_settings/message_sender number envelopes from demo_ui.seq without catching it up to session.last_seq
trigger: In a screenshot demo, before any album/outgoing send (the only two paths that fetch_max the counter), delete a message, pin one, send a sticker or GIF, archive a chat or mark it unread; or after QUILL_DEMO_UPDATE_STREAM has run (apply_json advances session.last_seq without touching demo_ui.seq)
effect: Session::apply drops the envelope as out-of-order-ignored (seq <= last_seq), so the action silently does nothing until the counter has caught up by repeated attempts
fix: One helper that stores last_seq into demo_ui.seq before every demo apply (as demo_apply_jsons/demo_delete_message do), or give the demo a single sequencer type that owns both counters, instead of syncing in some callers by hand.

title: An unlinked window still counts as replying
trigger: Type in a notification's reply field, then the chat is read/opened elsewhere (clear_custom_notifications) or Hide all is pressed.
effect: The window is unlinked and fading but Shown::replying stays true until it is removed, so held() blocks the other windows' fade and notify_start_all_hiding returns early for that time.
fix: Make replying part of the window's stage enum so unlinking leaves it; any_replying counts live windows only.

title: A notification is dropped silently when its window cannot open
trigger: A notification leaves the queue and open_window fails (display gone, window limit).
effect: Pending was already taken from the queue; only an eprintln is left, so the message is never shown by Quill's windows and no fallback runs.
fix: Put the Pending back at the head of the queue (retry on the next display change) or fall back to the system notification.

title: Failed image decode is cached for the path for the rest of the session
trigger: A pinned chat photo or sticker path is drawn before the file is readable/complete, or the file is later replaced at the same path.
effect: FILES stores Some(None) for the path; file_image returns None from the cache every time, so the pinned chat keeps its initials / the sticker stays blank until 512 other pictures flush the cache.
fix: Cache only successful decodes (or key by path+mtime/size); a miss retries.

title: Touch Bar model is rebuilt on every app notify on Macs without a Touch Bar and while hidden
trigger: Run Quill on any Mac (enabled() only reads the experimental option, not the hardware); keep an animation or poll running.
effect: Every notify schedules a 33 ms timer task that rebuilds the pinned panel (clones titles, photo paths for all pinned chats) and applies it to AppKit, up to 30 times a second, also with the window hidden to the tray.
fix: Skip scheduling when the OS reports no Touch Bar / the window is not visible, and skip apply when the Bar equals the last one applied.

title: Touch Bar is bound to the first main window; a main window reopened after GPU loss is never attached
trigger: GPU is lost; startup_failure::device_loss reopens the main window (attach_main_window runs again, os_menus::install does not). Press a Touch Bar item.
effect: The command task's update_in on the dead window fails and its loop breaks, `handle` for sync is stale and HOST keeps the old NSWindow, so the new window has no Touch Bar and later touches pile up in INBOX unread.
fix: Install per main window from attach_main_window (a WindowSlot-like owner that drops HOST/INBOX with the window), not once per process.

title: Dropped pinned chat jumps back until TDLib echoes the new order
trigger: Drag a pinned chat to a new slot and release; any app notify syncs within ~33 ms, before TDLib answers setPinnedChats.
effect: finish_drag reorders the local entries, but the next set_pins gets the model's old order (same_order false), rebuilds the entries in the old order (the picture snaps back), then moves again when the server update arrives. If the request fails the picture stays in the old order with only a note.
fix: Keep an expected-order stage (Reordering{ids}) in the panel that set_pins honours until the model shows that order or the command fails.

title: Touch commands carry bare ids with no account or screen epoch
trigger: Tap a pinned chat/sticker, or drop a reorder, while an account switch lands between the tap (bar still shows the old account for up to ~33 ms) and the command running.
effect: OpenChat(ChatId), SendSticker(file_id) and ReorderPinned(ids) are applied to the account now on screen: opens an unrelated/missing chat, sends a sticker file id of the other account, or sends a pin order of the other account's chats (TDLib error note).
fix: Stamp each Command with the ScreenEpoch of the Bar it came from (in_screen_scope) and drop it when stale.

title: The 4-hour recheck replaces 'Updated to Quill X' without acknowledging the changelog, so the banner comes back on the next launch
trigger: Install an update and start Quill on 'Updated to Quill X'. Leave the banner and the Settings changelog alone, keep Quill running for 4 hours, then restart.
effect: UpdateState::Installed maps to UpdateControl::Check { busy: false }, so the timer's check_for_updates runs and overwrites Installed with Checking and then UpToDate. The banner and the 'Dismiss changelog' button disappear, but acknowledge_changelog never ran, so the result file stays and the next launch shows the banner again. A dismissed banner (update_banner_dismissed) is also reset by the check.
fix: Keep the changelog in its own value (Installed { release, dismissed }), apart from the check state, so a recheck cannot drop it. Or skip the timer check while Installed is unacknowledged.

title: A disk dip shorter than the download's reaction time leaves the update at 'Update Quill' instead of resuming
trigger: Let an update download start, then let the disk go Low and back to Healthy within a moment, before the download thread notices the hold.
effect: hold_update_download sets the hold. On Healthy, auto_download_update calls download_update, which returns at once because the state is still Downloading. The old download then fails as held and finish_update_download sets Available. Nothing starts it again until the next disk transition or the 4-hour check, so the title bar shows Update Quill instead of downloading.
fix: Make a held download a stage of its own (Downloading { held: true }) that resumes on Healthy when its answer lands, or have finish_update_download restart it when the disk is already healthy.

title: The frozen-account and age-check box flags stay set when their condition clears, so the box reappears unasked
trigger: Open the frozen-account details from the banner (or the age prompt by turning on 18+ content). The server lifts the freeze, or the age check is completed in the browser, while the box is open. Later the account is frozen again, or verification is required again.
effect: account_notice() shows Frozen only while freeze_info_open && sync.freeze.is_some(), so the box vanishes when the freeze clears, but freeze_info_open stays true. When freeze is set again in the same session, the box pops open without a click. age_verify_open has the same shape. The two flags and age_verify_started also describe one box with no single owner.
fix: One value for the open notice (enum OpenNotice { None, Frozen, AgeVerify { started } }), cleared when its condition goes away (in the dialog sync) as well as by Close and Esc.

title: The X11 connection is cached for the process even after it breaks
trigger: On X11, have the X connection fail after first use (Xwayland or the X server restarted under a running session, or the connection hits an error); then use Close to tray / pin on top / Show taskbar icon.
effect: CONNECTION keeps the first RustConnection forever; once it errors every set_visible, set_always_on_top, set_skip_taskbar and is_minimised call fails silently (hide does nothing, minimised reads false) until Quill restarts.
fix: Drop the cached connection when a request on it fails (`Option` replaced by `Connected | Broken`), so the next call reconnects.

title: The per-window applied-frame map keeps an entry for every window ever opened
trigger: Open and close chat windows, call windows and notification popups for a long session.
effect: APPLIED (thread-local HashMap<WindowId, bool>) gains an entry per window in sync() and nothing removes it when the window closes: state that outlives its window, a slow leak.
fix: Keep the applied frame in the window's own state (WindowSlot / the window view) or remove the entry from when_window_goes.

title: The update helper gives up after 30 s of waiting for the app to exit and starts the old Quill again while the first one is still quitting
trigger: Press Restart to update while Quill takes long to quit (several accounts closing TDLib, a slow disk), or on Unix after the pid is reused by another process.
effect: restart_to_update hands off and calls cx.quit(); wait_for_parent polls kill(pid, 0) for 30 s at most. If the quit is slower, install() fails, apply_plan writes a failed receipt and relaunches the old version, which then meets the still-running process (single-instance lock) and opens with 'Update installation failed'. A reused pid has the same effect.
fix: Wait on something only the parent holds (the claim's lock, already shared with the helper) instead of the pid, with no fixed deadline while that lock is held.
